data.comment:
# Comfy Pruna P-Video 2- Text to Video

Generate videos from a single text prompt with Pruna P-Video-2, producing 1-20 second clips up to 1080p at 48 fps with native audio, including ambience, sound effects, and lip-synced dialogue from an optional last-frame image. Ideal for narrative shorts, motion posters, ad B-roll, and dialogue shots. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_pruna_p_video_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: A lone lighthouse on a black basalt island, huge slow waves exploding against the rocks in white spray. The camera drifts sideways past the lighthouse as its beam sweeps once through the sea fog, momentarily lighting the rain of droplets in the air. A flock of gulls scatters off the cliff edge into the wind. Cold blue-grey dawn light, one warm lamp glow in the tower window. Roaring surf, deep wind, a distant foghorn.
